idea-plugin.description:
Opt-in C# formatting after automatic or manual saves in JetBrains Rider, using the built-in Reformat Code profile.

Enable formatting for each project from Tools → Enable Native Auto-save Formatting. It is disabled by default for new projects. The plugin formats after the initial save, so file watchers may observe more than one write.

Compatible with the bounded Rider build range listed for this release.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial release: per-project C# formatting after automatic or manual saves using Rider's built-in Reformat Code profile.

action.description: Enable C# auto-save formatting for this project only
